hero.title: Analyze any broadcast match.
hero.subtitle: Paste a YouTube link or upload the TV feed. PitchVision finds every player and the ball, splits the teams, and draws the tactical map — in minutes, not hours.
hero.chips: Detection · Tracking · Team split · Tactical map · Annotated exports
hero.demoLabel: Example: a broadcast frame with tracked players next to the tactical map

features.title: From the TV feed to tactical data

broadcast.title: Made for broadcast footage
broadcast.body: Wide shots are analysed; replays and close-ups are recognised and skipped, so a 90-minute match with cuts just works.

tracking.title: Players, teams and the ball
tracking.body: Every player gets a track and a team from the kit colours. Rename teams, fix a goalkeeper, set the attacking direction.

map.title: Tactical map in sync
map.body: Positions on a 105 × 68 m pitch, frame-exact with the video. Calibrate the pitch by hand when the automatic mapping is unsure.

exports.title: Clips you can share
exports.body: Export annotated MP4s — boxes, labels, the ball, trails and the map side by side — for any part of the match.

steps.title: How it works
steps.one: Add a match: YouTube link or file upload.
steps.two: We analyse it on GPUs and email you when it is ready.
steps.three: Confirm the teams, explore the map, export clips.
